name: NAFT
tagline: Job marketplace app connecting job seekers, freelancers and employers in Uzbekistan
role: React Native app development with a small team

scenes.title: Jobs, workers and companies
scenes.body: Each side of the market gets its own tab, and lists load from the REST API ten at a time as you scroll.

scenes.title: Job posts with the terms up front
scenes.body: Pay, job type, city and duration come first in every post, followed by the brief, required skills and files.

scenes.title: Worker profiles that build trust
scenes.body: Rate, city and member year, job counters, skill levels, awards and past work on one scrolling profile.

scenes.title: Sign-up and company pages
scenes.body: Phone sign-up with a verification code; employers add staff size and department and get a page of openings.
